Messages.Author: Mat
Messages.Body:
Is the basic damage dealt by a Renegade Garou considered "Hand Damage"
?
What does a Grou with a Meat Cleaver do ? With a Wooden Stake ?

Thanks in advance,

Mat

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Mat wrote:
>
> Is the basic damage dealt by a Renegade Garou considered "Hand Damage"
> ?

"hand damage" is the type of damage done by a hand strike. [6.4.5]
The garou's default strike is a hand strike (as is any minion's), and
that strike deals 2 damage (i.e., the Garou's strength is 2).

> What does a Grou with a Meat Cleaver do ? With a Wooden Stake ?

Cleaver: 3 melee weapon damage (each strike).
Stake: 2 melee weapon damage (each strike).
